description: Android Fragment class for displaying and managing deleted notes, including menu options, navigation, and dialog interactions.

classes.name: DeletedFragment
classes.description: A fragment managing the display and actions for deleted notes, including menu handling and navigation.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for the fragment.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections such as empty bin, show hidden notes, select all, and search.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Updates UI based on data changes, particularly note deletion time.

methods.name: onNoteClick
methods.description: Handles click on a note, navigating to the editor with animation.

methods.name: onNoteLongClick
methods.description: Handles long click on a note, showing a menu.

methods.name: showEmptyBinDialog
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog to empty the bin.
